title: Naruto to Return With New Shonen Jump Crossover Anime No Fan Could’ve Seen Coming
content:
It’s official, Naruto is now on the works for a return from the classic anime franchise but it’s with a crossover that no fan could have ever seen coming. Naruto fans have been eagerly waiting for the franchise to make its proper return as following the 20th anniversary of the Masashi Kishimoto’s franchise, it was first confirmed that Naruto was in the works on a new anime revival. This has finally been revealed as part of the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend , but it’s a series that no fans could have guessed.

Shueisha had officially revealed that Naruto would be showcasing the first look at Naruto’ s brand new anime return during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend , and it turns out to be a new crossover with a major Shonen Jump classic series, Koji Kiriyama’s Ninku. The two ninja hits are crossing over in a brand new story in a collaboration between both Masashi Kishimoto and Koji Kiriyama, and the first look at this crossover has been revealed with a new trailer. You can check it out below.

New Naruto x Ninku Shonen Jump Anime Crossover Announced

Directed by Noriyuki Abe with chief animation and character designs provided by Tetusuya Nishio, these two staffers not only worked together on the classic Ninku anime series from the 1990s but also have experience with Boruto: Naruto Next Generations and the Naruto anime franchise releases. Both Naruto creator Masashi Kishimoto and Ninku creator Koji Kiriyama have worked together to help create the original story for the new Shonen Jump crossover. As Kishimoto stated with a special message during the panel, Ninku was a great inspiration to his work on Naruto .

Naruto x Ninku will be a special anime that taps into the full nostalgia of both projects. Not only is Ninku going to get a proper facelift in order to better fit into the modern era, but Naruto ‘s original incarnation of Team 7 will be front and center (though it was revealed during the panel that Kakashi won’t make the jump to this other universe) with this crossover as well. This includes the younger versions of Naruto, Sakura and Sasuke and this seems to be the full incarnation of the revival anime special that had been announced back in 2023 before being hit with an indefinite delay.

What Is Ninku Anyway?

Koji Kiryama’s Ninku first made its debut in the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 1993, and ran for two years before returning for an official sequel sometime after. This then led to a successful TV anime series outing with 55 episodes, and a few feature film outings to boot. The series introduced fans to a wild looking new boy named Fusuke who comes from the titular Ninku school that mixes ninjutsu and kung fu. But this is going to be the first new anime release for the franchise in 30 years.

This was the four episode revival series that Naruto had previously revealed to be in the works, but clearly has taken on a shape that no anime fan could have ever seen coming. It’s a dream project for Kishimoto as he’s revealed that Ninku was a big inspiration for his own work, but fans of the franchise might not feel the same way after waiting for so long to see more of what they hoped would be a more proper return from Naruto.

How do you feel about this first look at the Naruto and Ninku crossover? Is it the kind of anime return you had been hoping for? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Kolkata Anime India Convention to Take Place on February 27-28
content:
The convention will host its first-ever Hyderabad event on November 14-15 at The Address Convention Centre, Narsingi.

Naruto director Hayato Date ( Naruto Shippūden , Flame of Recca ) attended the Mumbai 2026 event as a guest. Voice actor Akari Yura ( The Beginning After The End , Catch Me at the Ballpark! ) performed as a musical act at the convention's concert, and Luna Goami ( Sparks of Tomorrow ) and Mofmofmo performed at the concert. ASCA ( Sword Art Online: Alicization , Edens Zero ) also performed at the event. Producer Ryōta Hasegawa ( Dr. Stone , Sakamoto Days ) attended the event as a guest. The event hosted meet and greets for all four musical artists as well as with Ryōta Hasegawa . Kadokawa participated in a "fireside chat" in the event's Animation & More Summit, as did ' Sony YAY!'

Anime India hosted voice actor Kazuhiko Inoue ( Naruto , Parasyte -the maxim- , 2025 Ranma ½ ) as a guest at its event in Delhi. Delhi Anime India took place at Yashobhoomi Convention Centre on June 6 and June 7. YURiKA ( Little Witch Academia , Miss Kuroitsu From the Monster Development Department ) performed at the event as well.

Anime India hosted its Kolkata event at Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan on February 14 and February 15. The event featured a panel and a workshop by director Susumu Mitsunaka ( Haikyu!! director, Weathering With You key animator).

Anime India's previous Mumbai event took place in 2025 from August 22 through August 24 at NESCO BEC in Mumbai. Director Tetsuro Araki attended the event as the "flagship guest." Voice actor Tsunko ( D4DJ First Mix , D4DJ All Mix ), president of Avex Pictures ' Hideo Katsumata , and DJ Tōko Nakamura also attended the event as guests. Hikari Dobashi attended the event as an exhibitor representing TV Tokyo .

title: Crunchyroll Acquires Indian Rights to The Apothecary Diaries Anime Film
content:
The company has acquired the North American and worldwide rights (excluding Asia but including India) for the film.

The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11 and will feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . Mariya Ise joins the cast as Mu Qing (English romanization not confirmed).

The story follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to the hometown of a concubine who died five years ago in the imperial harem, to return her remains to her homeland. There, they encounter pirates, hidden treasures, the secret of the Empress' remains, and a mysterious boy who holds the key to the story.

The third television anime season premiered on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll is streaming the season in India.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime in India as it aired in Japan and also streamed an English dub . The Tamil and Telugu dubs for the season streamed in July 2024. Netflix added the anime in April 2025.

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll streamed the season in India as it aired in Japan and also streamed an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print.

title: Naruto x Ninku New Collaboration Anime Announced, Revealed to Be the 4-Episode Project
content:
The completely new NARUTO anime first announced for the series’ 20th anniversary has finally been revealed as a four-episode collaboration with NINKU .

The project was originally scheduled to air on TV Tokyo for four consecutive weeks beginning September 3, 2023, but was postponed shortly before broadcast so the production team could further improve its quality. No major update followed for more than three years.

The newly revealed anime will tell an original story in which a young Naruto Uzumaki becomes lost in the world of NINKU while carrying out a mission.

The project was revealed as part of the latest NARUTO anime announcements at New York Comic Con 2026. Ahead of the event, the official NARUTO website had confirmed that the “NARUTO: What’s Next?” stage would feature a world-first reveal concerning completely new animation for the franchise.

While NINKU is considerably less familiar to international audiences than NARUTO , the connection between the two series goes back decades.

Created by Koji Kiriyama, NINKU began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump in 1993. Its story follows Fusuke, a young former member of the Ninku Corps who uses “Ninku,” a martial art combining ninjutsu and karate. After a major war, Fusuke travels through a troubled world while searching for his kidnapped mother and fighting enemies targeting former Ninku fighters.

Studio Pierrot adapted the manga into a 55-episode television anime that aired on Fuji TV from January 1995 to February 1996. Noriyuki Abe directed the series, with Hiroshi Hashimoto in charge of the series composition and Tetsuya Nishio and Mari Kitayama as character designers.

NARUTO appeared at New York Comic Con on October 10, where “exciting new updates” were revealed. Junko Takeuchi, the Japanese voice of Naruto Uzumaki, and Noriaki Sugiyama, the Japanese voice of Sasuke Uchiha, attended as special guests.

ALSO READ: Interview: Naruto Composer Yasuharu Takanashi on Far East Groove EU & UK Tour

NARUTO is a manga written by Masashi Kishimoto. It began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump in September 1999 and ran for 15 years until November 2014, ending with a total of 72 volumes. Studio Pierrot animated the anime adaptation, which premiered in October 2002 and ran for 220 episodes. The anime was followed by a sequel titled NARUTO Shippuden , which ran for 500 episodes. There is also the sequel BORUTO: NARUTO NEXT GENERATIONS manga, originally written by Ukyo Kodachi. Masashi Kishimoto later took over the story, which has illustrations by Mikio Ikimoto. The manga started in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2016 but moved to V Jump in 2019. Part 2 of the manga titled BORUTO: TWO BLUE VORTEX began in August 2023. The BORUTO: NARUTO NEXT GENERATIONS anime adaptation began broadcasting in April 2017, while the anime went on a break in March 2023. A 4-episode special was originally scheduled to broadcast for 4 consecutive weeks from September 3, 2023, but was delayed to ‘improve quality.’

A new NARUTO Card Game TCG was also recently announced for 2027, as well as a non-verbal live-action show set to run at Kyoto’s Minamiza Theater from February until June 2027. The live-action film directed by Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton recently began a cast search for Team 7’s Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura.

title: Shonen Jump’s Newest and Hottest Leading Manga Reaches a Major Milestone
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has evolved a lot over the last few years, and not necessarily in a good way. In recent years, more manga have ended or been cancelled than have debuted. The magazine has especially struggled to find new leading series besides One Piece . Before 2024, several strong series emerged as its leading titles, including Jujutsu Kaisen , My Hero Academia , and Black Clover . All these series helped Shonen Jump thrive on a different level. However, ever since two of these manga ended in 2024 and the third shifted to another magazine, Shonen Jump has struggled to find long-running series.

However, a few series have emerged, including Sakamoto Days and Kagurabachi , which debuted in 2020 and 2023, respectively. Both quickly gained popularity and helped the magazine establish new leading titles, with Kagurabachi surpassing 100 chapters. This milestone is a sign that the manga is thriving, and with its anime adaptation also announced, it is poised to become an even bigger success, especially as Sakamoto Days is also approaching its conclusion . However, another manga, Ichi the Witch , which debuted in 2024, has achieved a major milestone that further confirms its rise as one of Shonen Jump’s hottest new leading series.

Shonen Jump’s 2024 Manga Just Achieved the Perfect Milestone to Prove It’s a Leading Series

In Weekly Shonen Jump’s 45th issue of 2026, Ichi the Witch released its 100th chapter, becoming one of the few manga series to reach this milestone in recent years. However, while other manga series have also achieved this feat, Ichi the Witch has maintained consistently high viewership for its chapters, ranking only behind Kagurabachi in terms of views. This is further proven by the manga’s sales, with over 2 million copies sold across its eight volumes , as reported in July of this year. These are significant numbers that continue to prove it is a leading series, especially when compared with other shonen manga.

For instance, Shinobi Undercover, the manga that debuted right after Ichi the Witch and will also reach the same milestone next year, has struggled to achieve comparable sales. Its latest volume reportedly sold barely 2,000 copies, compared to over 100,000 copies for Ichi the Witch ‘s latest volume. The reason behind Ichi the Witch ‘s success is evident in its narrative, which perfectly captures the nuances of a shonen series while introducing its own unique premise. By focusing on Ichi, a boy who becomes a witch in a world where only females can become mages, the series embraces the unconventional premise that Shonen Jump manga often explore.

As the narrative has progressed, it has introduced other elements, including the emotional growth of not only the protagonist but also the other characters, while forming a new, cool male duo in Shonen Jump that has not been seen since Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s Yuji and Todo . In fact, Ichi and Gokuraku’s duo might even rival this iconic pair. The series is now featuring a major arc that continues to explore character bonds and growth, making Ichi the Witch an increasingly compelling shonen series. Its anime adaptation could become the next big Shonen Jump event, further reinforcing the manga’s leading position. Given its achievements, fans can expect an announcement at any time, with the anime potentially arriving in Fall 2027 or early 2028.

title: New One-Punch Man Season 3 Trailer Hypes 2027 Return – Watch Now
content:
One-Punch Man is gearing up to make its return for Season 3 next year, and the first trailer for the next half of the season is showing off the first look at what’s coming next. One-Punch Man has unfortunately been one of the most divisive anime series of the last few years. Although it’s in the midst of celebrating its 10th anniversary, all fans can really think about is the gap in visual fidelity between its first and later seasons . But there’s a path to redemption with its third season.

One-Punch Man Season 3 wrapped up its first half of episodes back in 2025, but quickly confirmed that a second half of episodes were now in the works . One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2 has revealed the first look at its new episodes during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend, and with it has confirmed that they will be making their debut next January. You can check out the first trailer and poster for One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2 below as shared by Viz Media.

One-Punch Man Season 3 Confirms January 2027 Return

One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2 will be making its debut sometime in January 2027 as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, but a more concrete release date or streaming platform has yet to be revealed as of this initial announcement . You can currently catch up with all of the episodes available thus far now streaming with Hulu in the meantime, and there is both Japanese and English audio available. But there’s a lot to look forward to in the coming episodes when the new season makes its return.

One-Punch Man Season 3 has also revealed the new opening theme for the series titled “Never Done -SUPREME POWER VS ULTIMATE FEAR-” as performed by JAM Project, and fans get the first taste of that theme with this new trailer. Shinpei Nagai will be directing the new episodes J.C. Staff with Tomohiro Suzuki providing the series composition, Makoto Miyazaki composing the music, and Chikashi Kubota, Shinjiro Kuroda, and Ryosuke Shirakawa providing the character designs. With the same staff behind it all, fans have been a bit concerned .

What’s Going Down in One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2?

One-Punch Man Season 3 unfortunately continues to divide fans. While it was a step up from the troubled second season in a number of different ways, the third season still led to a lot of negative responses from fans. At the same time, the series has also continued to rank in some major ratings numbers for its release . This second wave of episodes could make this even bigger than the first half as there are even more fights between the S-Class Heroes and toughest monsters.

The massive Monster Association Saga from ONE’s original series is the longest in the series to date, and it’s fully begun with the third season. There are some fights that push the S-Class heroes to new heights (with Tatsumaki getting an especially notable one we’ll see in this second half), and it’s all leading towards a final confrontation between Garou and Saitama we may or may not see soon. But what are you hoping to see with One-Punch Man’ s Season 3 return? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 22 Years Later, Fullmetal Alchemist Fans Are Still Debating the Anime’s Original Ending
content:
When it comes to anime series, not many of them can compare to the 2009 hit Shonen Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood . It’s one of the most ambitious projects by Studio Bones, and there’s no denying that the anime made its mark in history. Whether it’s the visuals, political intrigue, action, suspense, or even the world-building, the anime stands out in almost every aspect. Not only that, but the anime is still considered one of the highest-rated series of all time. As a Shonen classic, its legacy is still unmatched even now. However, the 2009 series is actually a reboot, and the original anime is far more divisive than most fans realize.

Written and illustrated by Hiromu Arakawa , the manga began serialization in 2001 before getting an anime adaptation two years later. Studio Bones was also responsible for the original anime, which aired for one year. The original series reached its conclusion on October 4th, 2004, but it left behind a never-ending debate over its ending. While it’s not as popular as the reboot, a majority of the fans have already watched the original series, and it’s pretty obvious why it needed a reboot. The story changed considerably from the original, making it one of the most controversial adaptations of all time.

Fullmetal Alchemis t: Brotherhood Is Still Known For Its Satisfying Ending

Before we get to what really happened in the original anime, it’s necessary to consider that the majority of the reason why the debate still exists is that the original ending is just that well-written. While the reboot does have a few changes from the original, it remains overall faithful to the entire story and, of course, the ending as well. Shonen endings throughout the decades have been criticized for rushed conclusions, unanswered questions, and many other issues. Things haven’t changed even now, as seen with the finale of even hit series such as Jujutsu Kaisen and Demon Slayer .

However, this is all the more reason why Fullmetal Alchemist stands out for having one of the best endings in Shonen history . The story ended without any plot holes or rushed pacing. Instead, it gave each character their version of an ending while also giving them a goal to carry on in the future. On the other hand, the 2003 anime was airing during the manga’s serialization, which is one of the reasons why it made several changes from the original story.

After the anime caught up with the manga, the animation studio decided to write a completely original ending instead of ending the series halfway. While the manga ended in 2011, the anime already decided how things would play out in an alternate version of the story. During the early 2000s, the anime was actually popular, but things changed significantly by the end of the decade and the early 2010s. The manga came to a satisfying conclusion, and even now, rarely any Shonen series can compete with how well-written Fullmetal Alchemist ‘s ending is. This is all the more reason why newer fans are still divided over the 2003 anime’s ending.

Fullmetal Alchemist ‘s Original Anime Isn’t As Bad As Many Fans Claim

Abiding by the standards of the 2000s anime industry, Fullmetal Alchemist added several fillers and even original scenes that completely deviated from the story that Arakawa had originally intended. When the anime broke through Arakawa’s narrative, it became much darker than the manga . The series changed how the Homonculi were created, which completely shifted the tone of the story. The original manga featured that the Homonculi were created with a Philosopher’s Stone, but the 2003 anime shocked fans when it confirmed these creatures came to life after a failed human transmutation. The concept of human transmutation was a taboo in both versions of the story.

However, the original story put emphasis on how the military doesn’t want anyone to create an army of the undying. Meanwhile, the 2003 anime featured a more ethical reason, stating that these transmutations lead to the creation of such dangerous artificial life forms. Additionally, in the first anime, it was Roy Mustang who killed Winry’s parents instead of Scar, which was a major turning point in the story. However, the biggest change was of course the finale, where Envy fatally stabs Edward in the chest. Unwilling to lose his brother, Alphonse decides to sacrifice himself to save him.

However, Edward somehow transmutes himself to save Alphonse instead, which gets him trapped in our real world. While Alphonse gets his body back, Edward decides to find a way to get back home, leaving the brothers separated forever. The original anime never really reunited the brothers and ended on a bittersweet note while they remain hopeful for the future. Surprisingly enough, if one can forget about the manga, the original anime is actually considered well-written even though it has its drawbacks.

What did you think about Fullmetal Alchemist ‘s original anime? Or do you think it should have ended on a happy note instead? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Crunchyroll Is About to Release a Ton of New Anime for the Biggest Webtoon Hits
content:
Crunchyroll is teaming up with HAYATE and LINE Digital to release a ton of new anime based on the biggest Webtoon hits, and fans have gotten the first look at some of the first coming our way in the near future. Webtoon fans have been able to see some of their favorite Korean webcomics making the jump to anime in the last few years specifically, and those have resulted in some record breaking successes such as with Solo Leveling . But there are even more series with that kind of potential.

As reading Webtoons grows in worldwide popularity, it’s opened up to a whole new avenue of potential adaptations to find the next big anime hit . Taking the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend, Crunchyroll has announced they are partnering with HAYATE and LINE Digital Frontier Corporation on a slate of new co-productions with the intent of adapting more Webtoons into anime. With the first look at a few of the titles revealed as well.

Crunchyroll Plans Anime for “Around” 15 New Webtoons

Crunchyroll, HAYATE and WEBTOON Entertainment’s LINE Digital Frontier Corporation are now working together to develop potential new anime adaptations for “around 15 select titles” as revealed by a new press release celebrating the partnership. Each of the titles can be found in LINE Digital Frontier’s webtoon services, and will be exclusively streaming with Crunchyroll upon their debut. While not all 15 of these titles might not make their way to screens in the future, the first three of these adaptations have been revealed during New York Comic Con 2026.

The first three titles getting their official anime adaptations include JH’s The Boxer, HereLee and SUMPUL’s The Remarried Empress , and YC and Rakyeon’s Teenage Mercenary . Both The Remarried Empress and Teenage Mercenary have revealed they are scheduled for a release some time in 2027, but a release window for The Boxer has yet to be revealed as of this initial announcement. If these shows can find success as the first major wave of this new partnership, it’ll be smooth sailing for the other titles they have planned.

What Does This Mean for Anime’s Future?

Anime fans have likely seen a lot of Webtoon adaptations over the last few years, and some of them have been much more successful than some of the traditional manga releases. Many of the biggest titles have accumulated billions of views for their original comics, and that success has translated to screens thanks to well received adaptations. If these Webtoon hits can continue to be paired with great studios and staff, then we’re bound to see much more from this partnership alone. Not to mention any other studios and companies that might want to jump on the trend.

Ultimately this also means many more quality stories are going to be available to watch through an anime. We’ve seen some earlier titles hit stumbling blocks with how they adapted their original Webtoon releases like The God of High School , but it’s much different these days as it seems like all those involved have figured out a better rhythm to go with it. As these series further make their way to screen, it’s also going to draw more interest to Webtoons too.

Which Webtoon series are you hoping to see get their own official anime adaptations in the future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Futurama Returns With Surprise Post-Credits Scene After Season 14 Finale – Watch
content:
Futurama has officially ended another season of its revival run with Hulu, but it’s made a surprise return with a new post-credits scene revealing what happened after the final episode. Futurama had four successful seasons of its revival series with Hulu, but the animated series thankfully is far from over. The franchise has revealed that it’s now working on three new specials for Hulu , and has some more surprises in store. That includes a brand new post-credits scene for fans to enjoy after Season 14’s big finale.

Futurama Season 14 ended on a finale that was written to be yet another potential series finale for the franchise before it was renewed for its new specials with Hulu. But while the final moments of the finale put a fun button on the final adventure, Futurama returned with a brand new post-credits scene as shared with fans during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend to help bring the final episode to an even better conclusion. You can check it out below as shared by Hulu.

Futurama Finale Post-Credits Scene Teases the Show’s Future

Futurama Season 14 marks the end of an era with Hulu as it’s (currently) the final full season of the TV series planned for the streaming platform. But it’s not the end of the franchise as there are three new specials now in the works. The first is currently scheduled to release with Hulu during the 2027 holiday window, and has been teased to be an X-Mas focused adventure. There’s even a brief tease at what to expect with a flying reindeer briefly seen as the Professor teases that it’s something to come.

Futurama showrunner David X. Cohen teased to ComicBook that this new special “…involves a big Bender romance with a snowman,” and that “You’ll believe it when you see it.” It was also teased to focus more on Fry’s childhood hopes and dreams for the holiday, and would be a way for the staff to officially say goodbye to the late Coolio following passing with a tribute to Kwanzaa Bot of some kind. But that’s not all that’s in the works for the show’s future as the other specials are teasing something big.

What’s Next for Futurama?

As Futurama executive producers David X. Cohen and Claudia Katz explained to ComicBook, these new specials will be about 66 minutes each . So they won’t be as long as the previous feature length releases seen on DVD, but are being treated with the same amount of care, “Another way to look at it is basically it’s about the same amount of material as a season and we’re presenting it in a different way,” Cohen stated. “I think it could be quite exciting.” Even teasing that the third special would be following up a major theory fans have had for years too.

Futurama Season 14 was the biggest of the revival era yet. Not only did it end on what could have been yet another series finale for the long running franchise, but it also featured a crossover with Disenchantment on Netflix . This was a major team up between the two streaming services, and took quite a lot of time to put together. But with more Futurama still on the way, how do you like this new post-credits scene? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
